title: A must have in every laundry room
text: A must have in every laundry room. This works just great in my laundry room.  I simply take my clothes out of the dryer and hang them immediately. Lessens the wrinkling of clothing. No real installation, just place it over the top of your door and, voila, you are done! Great item.
